**4B.10 Research Note**

Verdict: **Weaker.** The best 2024 evidence shows Khamenei left Iran’s political freedom and democratic resilience worse than he inherited them: low-turnout, tightly vetted elections; continued repression of critics and journalists; and no meaningful opening of succession or oversight institutions. The only positive evidence is procedural and narrow, not enough to offset the broader pattern.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Iran bars Hassan Rouhani from seeking re-election to key body | The Guardian | 2024-01-25 | https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/jan/25/iran-bars-hassan-rouhani-from-seeking-re-election-to-key-body | The Guardian Council blocked Rouhani from the Assembly of Experts, which can appoint or dismiss the supreme leader. This is direct evidence that the succession system remained controlled rather than resilient. | 4B.10, 4B.8, 4B.4 |
| Iran: Chokehold on Dissent | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent | HRW reported killings, mass arrests, torture, and retaliation against protesters, critics, journalists, students, and activists. That is direct evidence of declining political freedom and weak democratic resilience. | 4B.10, 4B.3, 4B.5, 4B.6, 4B.9 |
| Iran election: turnout sinks to record low as polls close | The Guardian | 2024-03-02 | https://www.theguardian.com/world/world/iran-election-expected-turnout-mahsa-amini | The election environment was heavily constrained and reformists were widely excluded, with turnout falling to historic lows. That indicates a politically brittle system rather than a resilient one. | 4B.10, 4B.1, 4B.2, 4B.8 |
| Iran vote turnout hits historic low amid discontent | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-02 | https://www.theprint.in/world/iran-vote-turnout-hits-historic-low-amid-discontent/1986385/ | Reuters described the parliamentary and Assembly of Experts elections as legitimacy tests under tight restrictions, with turnout around 41%. This is evidence of a weakened democratic environment, not improvement. | 4B.10, 4B.1, 4B.8, 4B.2 |
| Iran’s presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879 | Reuters said Khamenei ensured hardline loyalists dominated the contest and the Guardian Council approved only five hardliners and one low-profile moderate from 80 applicants. That is evidence of managed politics, not resilient democracy. | 4B.10, 4B.1, 4B.2, 4B.5, 4B.8 |
| Iran pauses implementation of stricter hijab law for women | Euronews / AP | 2024-12-18 | https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women | The late-year pause is the main positive signal, but it was temporary and procedural. It does not offset the year’s broader repression or show a durable strengthening of political freedom. | 4B.10, 4B.7, 4B.9 |

**Search gap**
- I found no credible 2024 evidence that Khamenei made political freedom or democratic resilience stronger in any durable sense.
- The only positive items were temporary procedural retreats or the mere existence of elections and formal institutions, which were still heavily filtered and controlled.
